name: Jahaziel
overview: Jahaziel is a male Levite identified as a descendant of Hebron, as recorded in 1 Chronicles 23:19. He belongs to the Hebronite family, which traces its lineage to Kohath, a son of Levi. This places him within the priestly tribe of Levi, known for their service in the tabernacle and temple.
namesAndTitles: The name Jahaziel means 'G-d [El] will see,' reflecting a theologically rich Hebrew proper name. This meaning highlights the divine oversight and presence associated with the individual, although the name was not given directly by God according to the record.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Jahaziel as a descendant of Hebron, linking him to the Hebronite lineage within the Levites. Beyond this, no additional family relationships are detailed in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Jahaziel's significance lies in his identification as part of the Hebronite branch of the Levites, who were entrusted with specific religious duties. Being a descendant of Kohath situates him within a key priestly family responsible for sacred service. His mention in 1 Chronicles 23:19 underscores the importance of genealogical records in preserving the heritage and roles of temple servants in Israel's worship life.
